name: BET1-1-day-hides-at-night
note: A person flagged to hide by day is shown only at night (IL_0435).

name: BET1-2-rain-or
note: The weather hides only the flagged, and only in the rain (IL_0471).

name: BET1-3-night-first
old:
if (flags & BETONY_NPC_FLAGS.hideDay) return isDay ? false : !hideWeather;
  if (flags & BETONY_NPC_FLAGS.hideNight) return isDay ? !hideWeather : false;
new:
if (flags & BETONY_NPC_FLAGS.hideNight) return isDay ? !hideWeather : false;
  if (flags & BETONY_NPC_FLAGS.hideDay) return isDay ? false : !hideWeather;
note: The day bit is tested first: flags 3 and 7 are day-hiders.

name: BET1-7-dawn-every-frame
old: const dawn = !first && lastHour !== DAWN_HOUR && hour === DAWN_HOUR;
note: OnDawn is the hour's edge, not every frame of six.

name: BET1-8-first-frame-weather

name: BET1-9-dusk-at-dawn
old: const dusk = !first && lastHour !== DUSK_HOUR && hour === DUSK_HOUR;
new: const dusk = !first && lastHour !== DUSK_HOUR && hour === DAWN_HOUR;
note: OnDusk at eighteen.

old: if (!(latched === undefined ? latchModLoaded(BETONY_VENDOR, modSetting(BETONY_VENDOR, 'Enabled') === true) : latched === true)) return true;
